rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Move under src/components/configurator/parts/color-swatch and remove its public entry unless a current tracked external import is proven.

rows.decisionText: Rename the vague /controls family/entry to /dark-mode-toggle and remove the collective alias; it contains exactly one concept.

rows.decisionText: Delete the public family/export and replace local sites with ordinary composition; no external tracked import justifies a primitive.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

An explicit detent grip is one named slider-equivalent control whose pointer, touch, Arrow, Home, and End paths share activeSnapPoint, paint, stage, announcement, interruption, and PRM state; a fixed Drawer renders no drag affordance, and no historical Sheet alias survives.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Merge metric-badge, metric-cell, and metric-stack into src/components/metric with one /metric entry and explicit parts; delete all three old entries without aliases.
rows.contract: One Metric family owns badge/cell/row/stack presentations, numeric typography, trend/status/context, and token contract; three parallel public families are folded.
rows.mutationBite: Preserve any old metric subpath alias or duplicate token/writer across parts; clean-break/topology evidence must turn RED.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.
rows.concept: page position and direct navigation indicator
rows.contract: PagerDots exposes page count/current/direct navigation, accessible labels, roving/focus, dynamic count, and one velocity-bounded worm indicator with an instance-scoped SVG filter id; it has no Carousel coupling or document-global Goo dependency.
rows.mutationBite: Mount one global filter, duplicate a pager filter or clipPath id across instances, keep a dead Goo id/export, make dots clickable without labels/focus, or stretch the worm beyond neighboring pages; ownership, clean-break, selection, and motion evidence must turn RED.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.
rows.contract: Timeline owns chronological semantics, continuous/segmented/scrubber variants as one concept, stable event identity, active/progress state, semantic event-choice and marker operability, keyboard navigation, responsive layout, and shared motion.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Retain one public concept and remove shadcn/CVA/raw-utility styling authority, aliases, duplicated wrappers, and unowned CSS.

rows.decisionText: Facility-scale family is owned by BI.W-P033 + BI.W-P034 + BI.W-P035 + BI.W-P036 + BI.W-P037 + BI.W-P038 + BI.W-P039 + BI.W-P040 + BI.W-P041 + BI.W-P042 rather than a shallow duplicate component wave.
rows.contract: Dock has one state machine, public anatomy, functional-glass plate, selection identity, layer/focus owner, explicit overflow/layout modes, semantic controls, and one shared spring/morph spine.

rows.decisionText: Facility-scale family is owned by BI.W-P049 rather than a shallow duplicate component wave.
